programs.title: Hometown Stories
programs.desc: , Episode 14, Season 14. With colorful pile fabric and comfortable knits, Wakayama prefecture is drawing global attention as a textile hub. We bring you striking images of its machines and the beat of its factories. Soness Stevens, Hiroyuki Hamada, Koji Okubo, Yusuke Ito.

programs.title: Satoyama Kitchen Diary
programs.desc: . At the Satoyama Kitchen guesthouse in Hida Takayama, chef Nobuko, her cameraman husband Makoto and their cat Tama take us on a tasty journey of local cuisine served with a side of seasonal scenery.

programs.title: On the Wings
programs.desc: , Episode 3. Join us on a night flight to admire Japan's stunning views on a journey from Tokyo to Fukuoka. Behold the sublime beauty of Mt. Fuji at sunset and the sparkling night views of major cities.
